description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring Mr. A. M. Ariyarathne as a member of the Giribawa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Giribawa Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the declaration of a newly elected member to fill a vacancy caused by death, which falls squarely under Election-related matters.
